attributionPolicy: Every lore chunk is an editorial synthesis drafted by the Saalik team. The sourceIds on each chunk name the published references and custodial institutions that the chunk must be checked against before it is promoted from EDITORIAL_DRAFT to FIELD_VERIFIED; they are not direct quotations. Dates and attributions that rest on chronicle or oral tradition are marked as such in the text, and chunks with confidence 'low' must be reviewed with temple custodians (guthi members, priests, or monastery staff) before public release.
